resources.string: Linking proves which Telegram account this is, so your data consent and Cloud Tasks follow you to your other devices and come back after a reinstall. Your hidden chats and locked chats stay on this device. With your data consent, your tasks are kept in the cloud.
Send this code to the Zenlygram bot in Telegram.
Zenlygram now recognises this Telegram account on every device you link.

Unlinking signs this device out of your Zenlygram account. Your vault, locked chats, tasks and saved versions are never touched. While your data consent is on, Zenlygram will not link this account again by itself; link it again here.
Update Zenlygram to link this account.
The link could not be saved on this device. Try again.
This device could not be unlinked. Try again.
Your account is linked automatically after your data consent.
